claims.content: Record a voucher sales return by capturing mandatory distributor, salesperson, date, amount, and voucher details when a distributor returns vouchers to the MSIU sales team.

goal.raw_text: Record a voucher sales return by capturing mandatory distributor, salesperson, date, amount, and voucher details when a distributor returns vouchers to the MSIU sales team.

claims.content: VMU User
Distributor Master must exist to provide the list of valid Distributor Names.
Sales Man Master must exist to provide the list of valid Sales Man Names.
System date must be valid and available as the default for Sales Return Date.
A distributor is planning to return the vouchers back to the MSIU sales team.

trigger.raw_text: A distributor is planning to return the vouchers back to the MSIU sales team.

claims.content: The system displays the Voucher Sales Return interface.
The VMU User selects a Distributor Name from the list populated by the Distributor Master.
The VMU User selects a Sales Man Name from the list populated by the Sales Man Master.
The system defaults the Sales Return Date to the current system date (ensuring it is less than or equal to the system date).
The VMU User enters the Number of vouchers Returned.
The system calculates the Sales Return Amount based on the formula: No of voucher returned x whole sale rate.
The VMU User enters the Batch No and Voucher No for the transaction part.
The system validates that all information (Distributor Name, Sales Man Name, Sales Return Date, Sales Return Amount, Number of vouchers Returned, Batch No, Voucher No) is provided.
The system captures and records the sales return transaction.

The system prevents the user from completing the sales return transaction if any of the mandatory information (Distributor Name, Sales Man Name, Sales Return Date, Sales Return Amount, Number of vouchers Returned, Batch No, Voucher No) is missing.
The system rejects the entry or modification of a Sales Return Date that is greater than the current system date.
The system has captured the Distributor Name, Sales Man Name, Sales Return Date, Sales Return Amount, Number of vouchers Returned, Batch No, and Voucher No.
The Sales Return Amount is calculated as (No of voucher returned x whole sale rate).
All mandatory information for the sales return transaction is recorded in the system.
